hypothesis: Take on more clients without hiring. Partner-level, revenue-shaped. Reasoned from a prospect rejecting the hours-saved lever outright: 'what do I make per hour? That's not the issue.' UNTESTED - this is the variable under test.

body.en:
Hi {{firstName}},

Quick question about {{companyName}}'s busiest weeks.

When the deadline rush hits, the constraint usually isn't the work — it's that the same client questions arrive faster than anyone can answer them. Deadlines, what documents you need, what something costs.

We turn a firm's own fee schedule, deadlines and policies into a reply that's already sitting in each person's Outlook drafts. Their own wording. Nothing sends until they read it.

The point isn't saving minutes — it's taking on more clients without adding headcount.

Worth fifteen minutes?

{{sendingAccountFirstName}}

{{firstName}} — one detail I left out.

We build the knowledge base for you. Fees, deadlines, document checklists, engagement terms. Most tools hand you an upload box and wish you luck; that's why most firms never finish.

If the drafts aren't good enough to send after 30 days, you don't pay — and you keep the knowledge base.

{{sendingAccountFirstName}}

{{firstName}} — I'll stop here.

If it's useful later: it runs inside the Outlook your team already uses, it never sends anything on its own, and it runs on European servers.

The first two weeks are free and include the workshop and the setup; billing only starts on day 14. If {{companyName}} wants to try it, reply and I'll set it up.

{{sendingAccountFirstName}}
